<h2 id="FreeBSD-Team-Reports">FreeBSD Team Reports</h2>
<h3 id="_freebsd_foundation">FreeBSD Foundation</h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Links:<br/>
<a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/">FreeBSD Foundation</a> URL: <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/" class="bare">https://freebsdfoundation.org/</a><br/>
<a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/blog/technology-roadmap/">Technology Roadmap</a> URL: <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/blog/technology-roadmap/" class="bare">https://freebsdfoundation.org/blog/technology-roadmap/</a><br/>
<a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/donate/">Donate</a> URL: <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/donate/" class="bare">https://freebsdfoundation.org/donate/</a><br/>
<a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/our-donors/freebsd-foundation-partnership-program/">Foundation Partnership Program</a> URL: <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/our-donors/freebsd-foundation-partnership-program/" class="bare">https://freebsdfoundation.org/our-donors/freebsd-foundation-partnership-program/</a><br/>

<a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/our-work/events/">Foundation Events</a> URL: <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/our-work/events/" class="bare">https://freebsdfoundation.org/our-work/events/</a></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Contact: Deb Goodkin &lt;<a href="mailto:deb@FreeBSDFoundation.org">deb@FreeBSDFoundation.org</a>&gt;</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The FreeBSD Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit dedicated to advancing FreeBSD through both technical and non-technical support.
Funded entirely by donations, the Foundation supports software development, infrastructure, security, and collaboration efforts; organizes events and developer summits; provides educational resources; and represents the FreeBSD Project in legal matters.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">

Potential contributors have submitted their applications to Google, and we will learn how many FreeBSD projects will be funded on April 30.</p>

<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_advocacy">Advocacy</h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In the first quarter of 2026, our advocacy work focused on expanding our educational video content, reaching more viewers than ever, bringing the community together for a productive Vendor Summit, and reflecting on the work that is helping sustain and grow interest in FreeBSD.
Here are just a few of the ways the Foundation advocated for FreeBSD in Q1 2026:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Helped represent FreeBSD at FOSDEM 2026, SCALE 23X, AsiaBSDCon, and CHERI Blossoms Conference</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Began planning the <a href="https://wiki.freebsd.org/DevSummit/202606">June 2026 FreeBSD Developer Summit</a>, taking place June 17-18, 2026, co-located with BSDCan 2026; <a href="https://www.bsdcan.org/2026/registration.html">Registration is now open</a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Finalized our Silver Sponsorship of BSDCan and opened the <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/what-we-do/grants/travel-grants/">BSDCan 2026 Travel Grant Application</a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Signed for a Silver level sponsorship to <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/news-and-events/event-calendar/asiabsdcon-2026/">AsiaBSDCon26</a>, which took place March 19-22, 2026, in Taipei, Taiwan.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Deb Goodkin, Executive Director of the FreeBSD Foundation, will be <a href="https://osselcna2026.sched.com/event/2JQsf/what-running-freebsd-on-a-modern-laptop-taught-me-deb-goodkin-the-freebsd-foundation?iframe=no&amp;w=&amp;sidebar=yes&amp;bg=no">speaking at Open Source Summit North America</a>, hosted by the Linux Foundation on May 19, 2026</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Published the following blogs and videos to help to inform and educate the community:</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/blog/getting-ready-for-the-cyber-resilience-act/">Getting ready for the Cyber Resilience Act</a></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/blog/build-a-nas-using-freebsd-on-a-raspberry-pi/">Build a NAS using FreeBSD on a Raspberry Pi</a> (<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xqFiTRYo1fk&amp;t=1s">video</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/resource/getting-started-with-freebsd/">Getting Started with FreeBSD: A resource guide for beginners</a></p>
</li>

</li>
<li>
<p>Published the <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/news-and-events/newsletter/january-newsletter/">January 2026</a>, <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/news-and-events/newsletter/february-newsletter/">February 2026</a>, and <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/news-and-events/newsletter/march-newsletter/">March 2026</a> FreeBSD Foundation Newsletters</p>

<li>
<p>Released the <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org/our-work/journal/browser-based-edition/freebsd-15-0/">October/November/December</a> issue of the FreeBSD Journal with HTML versions of the articles</p>

<h4 id="_legalfreebsd_ip">Legal/FreeBSD IP</h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The Foundation owns the FreeBSD trademarks, and it is our responsibility to protect them.
We also provide legal support for the core team to investigate questions that arise.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Go to <a href="https://freebsdfoundation.org" class="bare">https://freebsdfoundation.org</a> to find more about how we support FreeBSD and how we can help you!</p>

<div class="sect2">
<h2 id="projects">Projects</h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<h3 id="_more_robust_pkgbase_conversion">More robust pkgbase conversion</h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Links:<br/>
<a href="https://github.com/FreeBSDFoundation/pkgbasify">pkgbasify</a> URL: <a href="https://github.com/FreeBSDFoundation/pkgbasify" class="bare">https://github.com/FreeBSDFoundation/pkgbasify</a><br/></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Contact: Isaac Freund &lt;<a href="mailto:ifreund@freebsdfoundation.org">ifreund@freebsdfoundation.org</a>&gt;</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The <a href="https://github.com/FreeBSDFoundation/pkgbasify">pkgbasify</a> script is used to convert non-pkgbase FreeBSD systems to pkgbase systems.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In the last quarter, I landed <a href="https://github.com/freebsd/pkg/pull/2627">several improvements</a> in upstream pkg, allowing pkgbasify to become both simpler and more robust.
At the same time, the dependency of pkgbasify on the etcupdate database in <code>/var/db/etcupdate/current</code> can be now be eliminated, making pkgbasify much more flexible.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>These improvements will be available to end users after the pkg 2.7 release.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Sponsor: The FreeBSD Foundation</p>
</div>
<hr/>
</div>

<h3 id="_kernel_benchmark_maintainers_and_pkgdist">Kernel Benchmark, MAINTAINERS, and pkgdist</h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Links:<br/></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p><a href="https://github.com/Humanoid-Human/fbsd-work/blob/main/kernel-benchmark.md">Kernel benchmark writeup</a> URL: <a href="https://github.com/Humanoid-Human/fbsd-work/blob/main/kernel-benchmark.md" class="bare">https://github.com/Humanoid-Human/fbsd-work/blob/main/kernel-benchmark.md</a><br/>
<a href="https://github.com/freebsd/srcmgr/issues/21">MAINTAINERS srcmgr thread</a> URL: <a href="https://github.com/freebsd/srcmgr/issues/21" class="bare">https://github.com/freebsd/srcmgr/issues/21</a><br/>
<a href="https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-src/pull/2107">MAINTAINERS pull request</a> URL: <a href="https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-src/pull/2107" class="bare">https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-src/pull/2107</a><br/>
<a href="https://github.com/Humanoid-Human/fbsd-work/pull/1">pkg to distribution set converter</a> URL: <a href="https://github.com/Humanoid-Human/fbsd-work/pull/1" class="bare">https://github.com/Humanoid-Human/fbsd-work/pull/1</a></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Contact: Trevor Xu &lt;<a href="mailto:trevorxu5@gmail.com">trevorxu5@gmail.com</a>&gt;</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>My work this term was split between three projects.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_kernel_benchmark">Kernel Benchmark</h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>I ran several benchmarks of FreeBSD 15.0-RELEASE, FreeBSD 16.0-CURRENT (default installation), and FreeBSD 16.0-CURRENT with kernel debugging disabled.
The purpose of this work was to provide proper measurements of the performance impacts of kernel debug tooling.
I found that the default installation of 16.0-CURRENT (i.e. with debug) was significantly slower than 15.0-RELEASE, particularly in areas such as memory allocation.
On the other hand, 16.0-CURRENT when configured correctly had performance comparable to 15.0-RELEASE in every test I ran.
A <a href="https://github.com/Humanoid-Human/fbsd-work/blob/main/kernel-benchmark.md">full writeup</a> is available.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_maintainers_modernization">MAINTAINERS Modernization</h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Based on the info from the <a href="https://github.com/freebsd/srcmgr/issues/21">srcmgr thread</a>, I made a layout for a UCL file that would store maintainers and paths to watch, as a replacement for the current MAINTAINERS file.
I then wrote a flua script that reads this file and can output CODEOWNERS for GitHub or Forgejo, get the maintainers for a particular path, get paths for a particular maintainer, etc.
The pull request can be found <a href="https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-src/pull/2107">here</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_pkg_to_distribution_set_converter">pkg to Distribution Set Converter</h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Currently working on writing a shell script that can convert a pkgbase package set into a distribution set.
This would help facilitate the transition to pkgbase.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Sponsor: The FreeBSD Foundation</p>
